title: Find a fortress and get blaze rods

steps.title: Find the fortress
steps.say: Nether fortresses are big castles of dark [Nether bricks](item:nether_bricks) with long bridges, often over lava. Explore the Nether until you see one.

steps.title: Find the blazes
steps.say: Look for a blaze spawner, a cage with fire inside, often on a raised platform.

steps.title: Get ready
steps.say: Blazes fly and shoot fireballs. A [shield](item:shield) and a [potion](item:potion) of fire resistance help a lot.

steps.title: Fight them
steps.say: Hit them with a [sword](item:wooden_sword), or shoot [arrows](item:arrow). [Snowballs](item:snowball) hurt blazes too.

steps.title: Collect the rods
steps.say: Blazes sometimes drop a [blaze rod](item:blaze_rod). Keep fighting until you have about 6 or more.

steps.title: Make powder
steps.say: Craft each [blaze rod](item:blaze_rod) into 2 [blaze powder](item:blaze_powder), for [brewing stands](item:brewing_stand) and [eyes of ender](item:ender_eye).

steps.title: Watch out
steps.say: [Wither skeletons](mob:wither_skeleton) live in fortresses too. Their hits turn your hearts black and drain your health.
